annotations.title: Quit or lost a job in Japan: ISA 14-day notice, Hello Work eligibility, health and pension switches

description: Applies Japan's post-employment checklist as of 2026-11-07 (ISA 所属機関に関する届出 pages, MHLW / Hello Work employment-insurance Q&A including the April 2025 給付制限 change, 協会けんぽ 任意継続, usual 14-day city / National Pension windows). jobEndDate required. status: work | student | dependent | pr_spr | designated | other (aliases 技人国, 特定技能, 留学, 家族滞在, 永住…). reason: company | self | contract_end | other (会社都合 / 自己都合 / 契約満了). insuredMonths tightens eligibility (company ≥6 in 1 year, self ≥12 in 2 years). lookingForWork, hasNewJob, newJobStartDate, healthPlan (undecided | voluntary_continue | national | family | new_employer), under60, today. Returns verdict (act_now | plan_ahead | eligible_benefits | limited), summary, immigration {notificationNeeded, notifyBy, threeMonthRisk, threeMonthDate, note}, unemployment {likelyEligible, why, waitingDays, restrictionMonths, earliestBenefitDay, applyAt, note}, health, pension, documents, deadlines, actions, warnings, sources, disclaimer. No yen amounts. Use for 'I quit my job in Japan what do I do', '所属機関に関する届出 期限', '雇用保険 自己都合 給付制限', '任意継続 国保 どっち', 'ハローワーク 外国人 離職票'. Educational, not immigration / labour / benefits advice; not affiliated with ISA, MHLW, Hello Work, the Japan Pension Service, 協会けんぽ or any city office.

insuredMonths.description: Employment-insurance insured months in the look-back window.

lookingForWork.description: Able and willing to work / job seeking (default true).
